scope: Exact normalized premise substring search only, not semantic near-duplicates.
Structured JSON strings and one additional JSON-escaped string layer are decoded; arbitrary encrypted, encoded, compressed or concatenated source literals are not reconstructed.
Scope is the prior census inventory: current phase-one audit work and pinned raw source presence excluded, no other-machine/team or binary-document completeness claim.
Payloads were deduplicated by their actual SHA; each readable artifact was verified and current text searched even if its inventory hash changed.
Candidate dev gold/label values are discarded by source input projection and are not used, scored or output.
